title: Las Vegas Tech Conference with Emergency Early Return

scenario.description: A solo traveler attending a tech conference in Las Vegas with planned weekend leisure. A sudden work emergency requires cutting the trip short by one day, forcing an early return flight and cancellation of remaining activities.

dynamic_events.description: A critical system outage at work requires you to be back in California by Saturday afternoon. You must change your return flight to depart Las Vegas no later than Saturday (2026-03-07) at 1:00 PM. You also need to cancel your Saturday night hotel stay and any weekend entertainment you had planned.
resolution_requirements: Change the return flight to depart on Saturday before 13:00
Reduce the hotel booking from 3 nights to 2 nights (checking out on Saturday)
Remove any activities or dining reservations scheduled after your new flight departure time
Ensure Thursday and Friday bookings remain completely untouched

expected_challenges: Agent must understand temporal boundary reduction and drop any events scheduled after the new departure time.
Handling hotel modifications (checking if the system allows modifying a 3-night stay to a 2-night stay, or if it requires full cancellation and rebooking).
Ensuring the agent does not accidentally wipe out the unaffected Thursday/Friday itinerary during the replanning phase.
notes: Tests timeline truncation. The agent must successfully navigate date mutations for the return flight and identify which downstream activities fall out of bounds.
